title: Attenuate the first Fourier cube with a higher-order Lie correction
statement: Define D6=sum_(F in twelve shears)[L_F,[L_F,D4]]. The phase sum is Fourier-diagonal; with D4(k)=kappa^4 d(k),p=k+sigma e_j,T=T_ij^sigma(k),Tb=T_ij^-sigma(p),R=TbT,the exact recurrence is D6(k)/kappa^6=-(1/2)sum[Rd(k)+d(k)R-2Tb d(p)T]. The source rational shell table yields Dcube=D4+D6/296 <=-(kappa^4/2000)I on EVERY divergence-free polarization with0<|k|infinity<=1,using39.4<kappa²<40. At k=2e1,D4/kappa^4=-14I/75 andD6/kappa^6=124348I/37125,so the same combination is positive there. This is a larger finite-region Lie-generator attenuation identity,not an explicit whole-space contraction word,arbitrary squeezing or full compiler.
